sections.h2: Beach Borough Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 226 residential sales closed in Beach Borough (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $507,500, above the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 32 days to sell, slower than the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Beach Borough sales closed between $339,925 and $675,000, or about $332 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($525,000, 106 sales) was about 5% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($499,950, 120 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Beach Borough sales were in ZIP code 23451.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About Beach Borough
sections.html: At a median $332 per square foot, Beach Borough sits 38% above the $240 citywide figure. 23% of sales here were detached homes, versus 61% citywide. 32% of the homes sold here were built in 2015 or later; across Virginia Beach the figure is 7%.

sections.h2: When Beach Borough Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:
Closings in Beach Borough were busiest in July (27 sales across the two years) and slowest in February (13 sales). Sold prices ran from $199,900 to $1,650,000, a spread of 8.3x between the lowest and highest sale. 52% of homes closed at or above list price and 10% closed at least 5% below it.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Beach Borough
sections.html:
23% of the sales were detached homes and 77% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,508 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,119 to 1,993 square feet. 44% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Home ages vary widely here: about 80% of sales were built between 1969 and 2025, with a median year built of 2001.
